import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int mod = 1000000007;
    static final int N = (1 << 20) + 5;
    static int n, lim, ans;
    static int[] p1 = new int[N];
    static int[] p2 = new int[N];
    static int[][] flag = new int[10][10];
    static int[][] a = new int[10][10];
    static int[][][] h = new int[10][10][10];

    static int fpow(int x, int y) {
        int res = 1;
        while (y != 0) {
            if ((y & 1) == 1) res = (int) ((long) res * x % mod);
            x = (int) ((long) x * x % mod);
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static int inv(int x) {
        return fpow(x, mod - 2);
    }

    static boolean check(int x, int y, int z) {
        int[] a = {x, y, z};
        int[] d = {0, 1, 2};
        do {
            if (flag[a[d[0]]][1] == 1 && flag[a[d[1]]][2] == 1 && flag[a[d[2]]][3] == 1)
                return true;
        } while (nextPermutation(d));
        return false;
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] array) {
        int i = array.length - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && array[i] >= array[i + 1]) {
            i--;
        }
        if (i < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        int j = array.length - 1;
        while (array[j] <= array[i]) {
            j--;
        }
        int temp = array[i];
        array[i] = array[j];
        array[j] = temp;
        reverse(array, i + 1, array.length - 1);
        return true;
    }

    static void reverse(int[] array, int start, int end) {
        while (start < end) {
            int temp = array[start];
            array[start] = array[end];
            array[end] = temp;
            start++;
            end--;
        }
    }

    static void dfs1(int P, int x, int y) {
        if (x == 7 && y == 1) {
            int sta = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                        if (check(i, j, k)) {
                            int x_val = 1;
                            while (x_val == i || x_val == j || x_val == k) x_val++;
                            int y_val = x_val + 1;
                            while (y_val == i || y_val == j || y_val == k) y_val++;
                            int z_val = y_val + 1;
                            while (z_val == i || z_val == j || z_val == k) z_val++;
                            sta |= h[x_val][y_val][z_val];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            p1[sta] = (p1[sta] + P) % mod;
            return;
        }
        flag[x][y] = 1;
        if (y == 3) dfs1((int) ((long) P * a[x][y] % mod), x + 1, 1);
        else dfs1((int) ((long) P * a[x][y] % mod), x, y + 1);
        flag[x][y] = 0;
        if (y == 3) dfs1((int) ((long) P * (mod + 1 - a[x][y]) % mod), x + 1, 1);
        else dfs1((int) ((long) P * (mod + 1 - a[x][y]) % mod), x, y + 1);
    }

    static void dfs2(int P, int x, int y) {
        if (x == 7 && y == 4) {
            int sta = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                        if (check(i, j, k)) sta |= h[i][j][k];
                    }
                }
            }
            p2[sta] = (p2[sta] + P) % mod;
            ans = (ans + (int) ((long) p1[lim ^ sta] * P % mod)) % mod;
            return;
        }
        flag[x][y - 3] = 1;
        if (y == 6) dfs2((int) ((long) P * a[x][y] % mod), x + 1, 4);
        else dfs2((int) ((long) P * a[x][y] % mod), x, y + 1);
        flag[x][y - 3] = 0;
        if (y == 6) dfs2((int) ((long) P * (mod + 1 - a[x][y]) % mod), x + 1, 4);
        else dfs2((int) ((long) P * (mod + 1 - a[x][y]) % mod), x, y + 1);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = scanner.nextInt();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                a[i][j] = scanner.nextInt();
                a[i][j] = (int) ((long) a[i][j] * inv(100) % mod);
            }
        }
        for (int i = n + 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            a[i][i] = 1;
        }
        int tot = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                    h[i][j][k] = 1 << tot++;
                }
            }
        }
        dfs1(1, 1, 1);
        lim = (1 << 20) - 1;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= lim; j++) {
                if ((j >> i & 1) == 1) {
                    p1[j] = (p1[j] + p1[j ^ (1 << i)]) % mod;
                }
            }
        }
        dfs2(1, 1, 4);
        ans = (mod + 1 - ans) % mod;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
